records.translation: Image UMAP skilar DataFrame með skýringum sem inniheldur tvívíð hnit og ``cluster`` merkingar, eða Matplotlib-mynd þegar ``return_fig=True``.  Eftir því hvaða stillingar gilda um vistun og teikningu skrifar hún einnig innfellinguna, klasasýnir, ristir af dæmigerðum úrklippum, eiginleikayfirlit og uppleystu stillingarnar við hlið verkefnisins.

records.context: THE ONE PLACE A NON-MATPLOTLIB RENDERER CAN ASK. ``save_figure`` rewrites the extension itself, which is why every matplotlib save has honoured the preference for months -- but pyqtgraph decides what it writes FROM THE NAME (``FastPlot.export`` branches on ``.pdf`` / ``.svg`` / else), so a renderer that is handed ``volcano.pdf`` writes a PDF whatever the user chose. The name has to be settled before the export sees it, and settling it twice in two modules is how the two drift apart.

records.source: THE ONE PLACE A NON-MATPLOTLIB RENDERER CAN ASK. ``save_figure`` rewrites the extension itself, which is why every matplotlib save has honoured the preference for months -- but pyqtgraph decides what it writes FROM THE NAME (``FastPlot.export`` branches on ``.pdf`` / ``.svg`` / else), so a renderer that is handed ``volcano.pdf`` writes a PDF whatever the user chose. The name has to be settled before the export sees it, and settling it twice in two modules is how the two drift apart.
records.translation: EINI STAÐURINN ÞAR SEM TEIKNARI SEM ER EKKI MATPLOTLIB GETUR SPURT. ``save_figure`` endurskrifar skráarendinguna sjálft, og þess vegna hefur sérhver matplotlib-vistun virt stillinguna mánuðum saman -- en pyqtgraph ákveður hvað það skrifar ÚT FRÁ NAFNINU (``FastPlot.export`` greinist eftir ``.pdf`` / ``.svg`` / annars), þannig að teiknari sem fær ``volcano.pdf`` í hendur skrifar PDF hverju sem notandinn valdi. Nafnið verður að vera ákveðið áður en útflutningurinn sér það, og að ákveða það tvisvar í tveimur einingum er einmitt leiðin til þess að þau tvö reki í sundur.

records.context: The session decides WHICH microscope fields of view and in what order -- reviewed ones already dropped, ``--limit`` already applied -- and this application view shows them. Only the nested layout is opened: this editor reads a draft from ``<folder>/masks/<stem>.tif`` and saves back to the same place, so a sibling or ``_seg.npy`` set would be read and written somewhere other than where its masks are. ``spacr-make-masks`` refuses those before Qt is imported; this is the second half of the same refusal, for anything that reaches the application view another way.

records.source: The session decides WHICH fields and in WHAT ORDER -- reviewed ones already dropped, ``--limit`` already applied -- and this screen shows them. Only the nested layout is opened: this editor reads a draft from ``<folder>/masks/<stem>.tif`` and saves back to the same place, so a sibling or ``_seg.npy`` set would be read and written somewhere other than where its masks are. ``spacr-make-masks`` refuses those before Qt is imported; this is the second half of the same refusal, for anything that reaches the screen another way.
records.translation: Lotan ákveður HVAÐA reiti og Í HVAÐA RÖÐ -- þeim yfirförnu er þegar sleppt, ``--limit`` er þegar beitt -- og þessi skjár sýnir þá. Aðeins hreiðraða skipulagið er opnað: þessi ritill les drög úr ``<folder>/masks/<stem>.tif`` og vistar aftur á sama stað, þannig að systkinasett eða ``_seg.npy`` sett yrði lesið og skrifað annars staðar en möskvar þess eru. ``spacr-make-masks`` hafnar slíku áður en Qt er flutt inn; þetta er seinni helmingur sömu höfnunar, fyrir allt sem kemst á skjáinn eftir annarri leið.
